strings.help_card: If tied, the highest number wins.
strings.help_firsttime_welcome:
Good day grasshopper,
And welcome to the Dojo.
Tell me what you seek.
strings.help_firsttime_tobegin:
To begin training,
You will first require these cards.
Just like real ninja.
strings.help_firsttime_improve:
To increase your rank,
You must compete in matches.
With hard work comes skill.
strings.help_firsttime_areyouready:
Like the autumn leaf,
You must be prepared to learn.
Are you ready now?
strings.help_firsttime_pickacard:
Each turn, both pupils
Pick a card to play. Secret.
Quiet. Like Ninja.
strings.help_firsttime_water:
The peaceful water,
Brings its soothing harmony,
And defeats fire.
strings.help_firsttime_snow:
The white frigid snow,
Brings with it the winter's chill,
And freezes water.
strings.help_firsttime_fire:
Furious fire,
Brings its mighty, scorching heat,
And will melt the snow.
strings.help_firsttime_tie:
When cards are the same,
The match is not yet over.
Highest number wins.
strings.help_firsttime_howtowin:
Much like the Forest,
There are two paths you can walk,
To reach victory.
strings.help_firsttime_winsame:
The first way to win:
Have three cards of the same type,
In different colors.
strings.help_firsttime_windifferent:
The second path is:
To have one of each card type,
In different colors.
strings.help_firsttime_ingamehelp:
If you should forget,
Mouse over the question mark,
And all will be clear.
strings.help_firsttime_joking:
Stand in the Dojo,
Half an hour, very still.
No... wait. Just kidding.
strings.help_firsttime_gainexp:
To become ninja,
You must gain experience,
From winning matches.
strings.help_firsttime_belts:
As you master skills,
I will award you new belts,
Of different colors.
strings.help_firsttime_fightme:
When you are black belt,
You must challenge me and win.
And I'm pretty good.
strings.help_firsttime_ninja:
When you best my skill,
Then you will be true master,
And become ninja.
strings.help_response_whatdoido: What do I do with these?
strings.help_response_howtowin: How do I win a match?
strings.help_response_becomeninja: How do I become a ninja?
strings.help_award_congratulations:
Congratulations!
Much like the fearsome earthquake,
You have rocked the house.
strings.help_award_belt_earned:
Well done. You have earned
%1 for your efforts.
I am proud of you.
strings.help_defeat_sensei_intro:
The gentle lotus,
Cowers before the storm cloud.
But you... you did not.
strings.help_defeat_sensei_kowtows:
Well done, grasshopper.
You have faced my skills, and won.
And proven yourself.
strings.help_defeat_sensei_gift:
Now receive the mark
Of a Card-Jitsu master,
With this ninja mask.
strings.help_defeat_sensei_final:
You may now join us,
In secret ninja hideout.
Congratulations!
strings.menu_description_competition:
Do you wish to play

strings.menu_description_sensei:
To become ninja,
You must challenge me and win.
But bring your black belt.

Do you wish to hear
The instructions of the game
Again, grasshopper?

strings.firehelp_firsttime_welcome:
Welcome, my student,
to the Volcano. Here your,
journey continues.
strings.firehelp_firsttime_welcome2:
Train here and you will
grow strong and learn the ways of
the Fire Ninja.
strings.firehelp_firsttime_welcome3:
To start you will need,
more cards for your deck. Take these
and begin. Good luck!
strings.firehelp_return_welcome:
Welcome back, student.
Card-Jitsu Fire awaits,
Challenge it... Or me...
strings.firehelp_return_bracers:
I see you’re wearing
the ancient Cloud Wave Bracers.
Forecast is cloudy...
strings.firehelp_return_tuba:
Ahh, the great tuba.
A graceful instrument, and
strong, like brass ninja.
strings.firehelp_return_partyhat:
I see you’re wearing
an anniversary hat.
I like pointy hats.
strings.firehelp_return_beta:
Ahh, the beta hat.
The most ancient of all hats.
I rarely wear mine.
strings.firehelp_return_santabeard:
Oh! You have a beard!
A fine choice. Mine helps me train...
Wait... Is that tied on?
strings.firehelp_return_puffle:
You brought a puffle!
Good thinking. Puffles taught me
much of what I know...
strings.firehelp_return_blackpuffle:
Heh heh, black puffles
have great power. They are true
masters of fire...
strings.firehelp_return_whitepuffle:
Your white puffle must
concentrate in this hot place,
for fire beats snow...
strings.firehelp_return_yellowpuffle:
Your yellow puffle
is drawn to the Fire Suit...
Keen artistic sense.
strings.firehelp_return_redpuffle:
Heh heh, red puffles
Have no fear of fire! Yours
laughs at danger’s face!
strings.firehelp_return_purplepuffle:
Your purple puffle
is loyal to follow you...
Most food gets burnt here.
strings.firehelp_return_greenpuffle:
Ahh, your green puffle
is ready for lava with
that propeller hat!
strings.firehelp_return_pinkpuffle:
Ahh, the pink puffle.
Secret masters of water...
Water beats fire...
strings.firehelp_return_bluepuffle:
The great blue puffle,
teaches us to hide our strength,
behind quiet face.
strings.firehelp_return_itemsquestion:
Ahh, I see you have
interest in my Fire Suit.
Want me to explain?
strings.firehelp_return_itemslevels:
Throughout this journey,
you will earn pieces to your
Fire suit.
strings.firehelp_return_itemschallenge:
Once complete, challenge
me and win to earn a gem
for your Amulet.
strings.firehelp_return_itemsgem:
Then, and only then,
will you have earned the title
of Fire Ninja.
strings.firehelp_return_volcanoquestion:
Your eyes reveal that
you have interest in this place.
Want me to explain?
strings.firehelp_return_volcanograsshoppers:
Then the orange sky
appeared, and smoke rose from
the mountain's summit.
strings.firehelp_return_volcanoonlyninja:
We stoked the fires,
and boom! Now Fire Ninja
have a place to train.
strings.firehelp_return_amuletquestion:
Ahh, I see you've found
my Amulet. Would you like
to know about it?
strings.firehelp_return_amuletpowerful:
This Amulet is
the key to the elements,
and their mastery.
strings.firehelp_return_amuletmasterelements:
As you continue
your journey, you will earn gems
that will prove your skill.
strings.firehelp_return_amuletsecret:
Carry it with you,
and it will open the way
to many places...
strings.firehelp_return_idleclickprompt:
If you see something
you find curious, click it
and I will explain...
strings.text_award1:
Good work young ninja!
You have earned the Flame Sandals.
Keep up the good work.
strings.text_award2:
I can see you have practiced!
You have earned the Magma Coat.
Well done, my student.
strings.text_award3:
You are very skilled!
You've gained the Lava Mask.
Don't stop. Keep it up!
strings.text_award4:
Excellent ninja.
You have earned the Fiery Helmet.
Now challenge me!
strings.text_award5_part1:
Congratulations!
You're now a Fire Ninja
and are now quite skilled.
strings.text_award5_part2:
Take this Fire Gem.
Add it to your Amulet
and wear it proudly.
strings.fire_gameover_message1:
Your amazing skill,
has brought you great victory!
You have earned first place!
strings.fire_gameover_message2:
Your skills are growing...
You nearly won, but this time,
you earned second place.
strings.fire_gameover_message3:
You gave it your best.
Keep training, and don't give up.
This time you're in third.
strings.fire_gameover_message4:
The road to winning,
can be a little bumpy...
You came in fourth place.
strings.fire_gameover_sensei_message:
To defeat Sensei,
You will need much more training
and experience.
strings.firemenu_description_competition:
Compete with other
students, master fire and
earn your Fire Suit.
strings.firemenu_description_sensei:
Challenge me alone
to prove your skill and become
a Fire Ninja.

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: There's talent in this audience. I can feel it

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: And the winner for best play is...

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Wow! The award for best costume goes to...

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Penguin play Award for best music goes to...

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: This year, best effects will be awarded to...

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Everyone's yawning. Quick - You!! Dance! Act! Sing!

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Hey you - Gross monster there! Settle down!

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Excuse me! Lady in red! Got an extra jewel?

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Hey fairy! Did you bring croissants?

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Yo! Bring over that shadow wave!

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Merman, dude. Can you stop splashing?

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Um... Who let lobsters in here?

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Shh! Let them speak.

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: What happens to us if the squid does not win?

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Everyone looks so absolutely fabulous.

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: I'm excited to see the winners on stage.

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Darling... You look marvelous...

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: [whispers] I simply adore your outfit.

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: Genius! This event is the best!

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: I get tired listening to boring speeches.

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: Let's all dress as lobsters and clap our claws!

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: Everybody on your chairs! ENCORE!

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: Are video cameras allowed in here?

stage_script_messages.name: Audience
stage_script_messages.message: How loud cam we get? Everybody CHEER!

stage_script_messages.name: Twee
stage_script_messages.message: Applause! Applause! Make it louder!

stage_script_messages.name: Bubbles
stage_script_messages.message: I'm just happy to have traveled here today.

stage_script_messages.name: Flippers
stage_script_messages.message: Can I tell a joke? Can I? Can I?

stage_script_messages.name: Ruby
stage_script_messages.message: This trophy will look perfect next to my ruby!

stage_script_messages.name: Hammer
stage_script_messages.message: The judges need to look at the nominees more carefully...

stage_script_messages.name: Hammer
stage_script_messages.message: I'll lend them a magnifying glass.

stage_script_messages.name: Squidzoid
stage_script_messages.message: PUNY AUDIENCE! I'M CLEARLY THE WINNER!

stage_script_messages.name: Shadow Guy
stage_script_messages.message: My fans make these fancy events worldwide!

stage_script_messages.name: Gamma Gal
stage_script_messages.message: Wouldn't be where I am now without bad dudes.

stage_script_messages.name: Twee
stage_script_messages.message: See how my wings sparkle?

stage_script_messages.name: Flippers
stage_script_messages.message: Did you hear about the A, B, Seas? Get it?

stage_script_messages.name: Lobster
stage_script_messages.message: You've had enough time on stage. MOVE ALONG!

stage_script_messages.name: Squidzoid
stage_script_messages.message: RAWWRR! YES! EAT TROPHY!

stage_script_messages.name: Ruby
stage_script_messages.message: Where's Jacques? Someone's lifted my ruby!

stage_script_messages.name: Shadow Guy
stage_script_messages.message: I'd like to thank my fans. And my Shadow Wave.

stage_script_messages.name: Gamma Gal
stage_script_messages.message: For great justice!

stage_script_messages.name: Host
stage_script_messages.message: Thank you! You've been a lovely audience!

evergreen.town: Welcome to the Town Center!|This spot is the heart of the island.|From here, you can get coffee|...dance at the Night Club...|...or check out the Gift Shop for some accessories.
evergreen.coffee: This is the Coffee Shop.|The coffee here is delicious!|You can also click the bag of coffee beans...|...if you want to play Bean Counters.|Or, serve up smoothies in Smoothie Smash!
evergreen.book: Here is the Book Room.|Click on the bookshelf to read something.|You can also play a game called Mancala.|It's a fun game, but difficult to learn.|Read How to Play Mancala before playing...|then play a few games to learn how it works.
evergreen.dance: Welcome to the Night Club.|This is THE place for dance parties.|That green puffle on the speaker is called the Keeper...|He was gone for a short while recently...|So it's good to have him back!
evergreen.lounge: This is the second floor of the Night Club.|It is called the Lounge.|The Lounge is great for relaxing after dancing.|There are also fun arcade games here!
evergreen.eco: This is the Recycling Plant!|Throw your recycling into the Recycletron 3000...|...and turn rubbish into useful things!
evergreen.shop: This is the Gift Shop.|You can buy clothes from the monthly catalog.|Colors and backgrounds can be bought as well.|Use coins you have earned from playing games.
evergreen.village: Here we have the Ski Village.|There's the Ski Hill, Ski Lodge and the Sports Shop...|...where you can buy lots of different sports equipment!
evergreen.sportshop: Welcome to the Sports Shop.|Here, you can buy all sorts of sports equipment.|There's absolutely nothing behind the rightmost change room.
evergreen.lodge: The Ski Lodge is a great place to warm up.|Or, you can play Find Four with friends.|You can also visit the Ice Pond out the back door.
evergreen.attic: This is the Lodge Attic.|It has been used to store just about anything!|It also has more Find Four tables.
evergreen.mtn: If you like to sled, come to Ski Hill!|I guess it should be called Sled Hill.|Bunny Hill is for newcomers, Ridge Run is only for pros.|The drop is almost straight down!
evergreen.pet: The Pet Shop is where you can adopt a puffle.|Puffles are animals native to Club Penguin.|They have different colors and personalities.|They all like penguins, and make great pets.
evergreen.dojo: Here we are in the Dojo.|Learn to become a Ninja with Card-Jitsu.|Train and earn belts to progress.|Only the dedicated will succeed.
evergreen.courtyard: This is the Courtyard.|It was covered in snow for many moons!|Enter the Dojo and take the path of the Ninja.
evergreen.hideout: Welcome to the Ninja Hideout!|Only ninjas have access to this special room.|Here you will find the Martial Artworks catalog...|Where you can buy lots of ninja clothing and furniture.
evergreen.pizza: This is the Pizza Parlor.|Come here to order the best pizza.|If you go into the kitchen...|...you can help make pizzas with the Pizzatron.|Also, serve pizzas by visiting the pizza oven!
evergreen.plaza: Greetings from the Plaza!|From here, you can visit the Pizza Parlor...|...watch a play at the Stage...|...or you can adopt a puffle at the Pet Shop.
evergreen.beach: This is the Beach, home of the Lighthouse.|It is a great place to relax in the sun.|Sometimes you see the pirate ship docked here!
evergreen.lighthouse: This is the Lighthouse...|...the tallest building in Club Penguin.|Take a look at the pictures on the wall...|...or grab a new instrument and perform on stage.|Go upstairs to find the Beacon!
evergreen.beacon: The Beacon holds the Lighthouse spotlight...|...and a telescope that you can look through.|And if you thought penguins could not fly...|...you should try the Jetpack game on the right.
evergreen.ship: This is the pirate ship, the Migrator. Arrrr!|Rockhopper sails the seas in this ship.
evergreen.shiphold: This is the ship's cargo hold.|Due to the crash the Migrator has faced...|...Rockhopper couldn't put his loot here.|Hopefully he will next time!
evergreen.shipnest: This is called the Crow's Nest...|...where Yarr keeps a lookout.|You can get a great view...|...of the island!
evergreen.shipquarters: This is the Captain's Quarters!|Rockhopper spends a lot of time here.|Look at the corkboard for his photos!|Or, grab a friend and hunt for some treasure!
evergreen.dock: Welcome to the Dock.|You can play Hydro-Hopper here.|Take a ride on a tube behind the speedboat.
evergreen.forts: These Snow Forts are fun for snowball fights.|Click the snowball icon to throw one.|Over there is the Club Penguin Journey clock.|It shows the time in the Penguin Standard Time Zone.
evergreen.rink: Welcome to the Stadium, sports fans!|Take part in the action and start a game!|Or grab a snack and watch from the bleachers.
evergreen.boiler: This is the Boiler Room.|It gives electricity and heat to the island.|Here you can read old editions of the newspaper.|It is a great way to learn about Club Penguin Journey.
evergreen.berg: This is the Iceberg. It is a secret room.|In the distance you can see Club Penguin.|If you want to dive into the ocean depths...|...try out the Aqua Grabber!
evergreen.cave: Here we have the Cave, which has its own pool.|It also has windows to see underwater.|Wait a moment, and a crab may walk by.
evergreen.shack: Welcome to the Mine Shack...|Home of the Mine and the Community Garden!|Help water the garden by throwing snowballs...|...into the green bucket.|Beside the beautiful tree is the Recycling Plant...|...where we use garbage to make useful stuff!
evergreen.mine: This is the Mine.|Puffles like exploring tunnels...|... and sometimes get trapped inside.|They need your help to rescue them!
evergreen.forest: Welcome to the Forest!|Go to the Cove by walking down those stairs...|...or take the top right path to the Mine Shack...|...and help out at the garden.
evergreen.cove: This is the Cove!|It is a wonderful, secluded spot.|You can go swimming in the shallow water here.|Or, test your surf skill and catch some waves!
evergreen.boxdimension: Welcome to the Box Dimension.|This mysterious place is the source of all boxes.|Please leave the laws of physics at the door.
evergreen.cavemine: Here we have the Mine Cave...|Many penguins mine the gold reserves down here.|So grab a hardhat and start digging!
evergreen.hiddenlake: Wow! This place is the Hidden Lake...|Where did all this treasure come from, I wonder?|And it looks like there's a door under the water...
evergreen.underwater: BLUB! This place is Underwater...|Look at all the colorful fish and plants! And treasure!|This sure is unusual...
evergreen.stage: Welcome to the Stage. Tickets please!|Many different plays are performed here.|A new play is put on every month or so!|If you're interested in a job...|...actors, directors, and stage hands are needed!
evergreen.welcome: This is the Welcome Room!|This is often the first place you visit.|If Club Penguin Journey is having a party...|...this room is usually well decorated for it.
evergreen.tourhq: This is the Tour Headquarters.|You can become a tour guide here...|...or go upstairs to view the island from the Lookout!|Click the box over there to send a suggestion for the game.
evergreen.lookout: Here we are in the Lookout.|This room has the best view of the island!|Be sure to check the room during events!
evergreen.oldboiler: The Old Boiler is quite unusual.|Penguins seem to have found this room by accident.|Be sure not to walk into this room's boiler.
evergreen.icepond: This is the Ice Pond!|Here, you can go ice fishing...|...or watch Fluffy the Fish grow big!
evergreen.hq: This room... is top secret, I can not tell you what goes on in here.|Oh, wait we are all agents here.| This room is the Agents Headquarters.|You can get here through the Sports Shop.|Or, you can just use your spy phone.|Click on a TV to go somewhere.
evergreen.pufflepark: This is the Puffle Park!|You can feed your Puffles...|...play with them...|...and let them go for a swim!|Over there is Puffle Launch and Puffle Roundup, give them a try!

party.houseentrance: We're outside the Haunted House.|If you're brave, take a look inside.|Or continue on the path to the Mine Shack.
party.party2: This is the Haunted House!|It's full of terrifying Halloween surprises...|and a reward for those brave enough to enter...
party.party3: The Dark Swamp! Oh my, this place is creepy.|This organ looks suspicious... if we work together, we will solve the puzzle.
party.party4: This is the dark chamber! Wait... who turned out the lights? Make sure you don't trip...|...and watch out for monsters that may be lurking...
party.party5: Wow! The Monster Room! Let's put on monster costumes and join in the fun!|Or head back to the Dark Chamber to spook more ghoul catchers!
party.party7: Yikes! Watch your step around that swamp... something's alive in there!

lines.text: It was a dark and stormy Halloween night.
Most penguins were sleeping peacefully after an evening of trick-or-treating,
but one igloo was still glowing silently in the snow.
Awoken by the howling wind, a penguin was spending the night decorating his igloo.
The bunting rustled as it was hung on the walls,
and the wooden chairs creaked as they were placed around a table piled high with candy.
The penguin dragged some pumpkins out of storage and placed them against the wall.
As he turned back to shut the closet door, he saw movement out of the corner of his eye.
He glanced back to the pumpkins... had that one just moved over an inch?
He shook his head, dismissing the thought.
As soon as he turned away, he thought he spotted movement again...
but the igloo around him was still...
BANG!
The closet door slammed shut! The penguin jumped, his heart pounding.
"It must be a breeze," he muttered, watching the candles on his chandelier flicker.
A sudden gust of wind snuck in through the window and blew out the flames.
The igloo fell into darkness…
except for an orange glow that cast long shadows on the walls.
The penguin slowly turned towards the light source...
and saw that it came from behind a lone pumpkin sitting on the other side of the room.
The penguin blinked. He didn't remember lighting any more candles...
or carving any jack-o-lanterns, for that matter...
The eerie glow began to spread across the walls, and the shadows moved around.
The penguin stood trembling but frozen to the spot,
as the pumpkin slowly turned, revealing a wide, toothy grin and gleaming eyes.
The penguin was petrified, holding his breath...
until something brushed against his flipper. He yelped and looked down.
It was only his green puffle, also looking nervous!
The penguin let out a sigh of relief and a small chuckle.
The "scary" jack-o-lantern was just his pumpkin puffle! How could he forget he just adopted one?
He shook his head at how silly he was being over nothing.
THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!
The sound came from the closet, like kicking against the door.
Trembling, the penguin opened it up...
and inside, nestled among the Christmas decorations,
sat his pumpkin puffle, its glowing eyes wide with worry.
The penguin scooped it up and ruffled its fur.
"Oh, there you are! But if you're here..."
Slowly, he turned back.
The jack-o-lantern now stood only a few feet away.
It almost seemed to grin wider for a second before its candle suddenly extinguished,
plunging the igloo into pitch black.
The penguin fumbled for a flashlight and flicked it on.
The beam swept across the room...
But the jack-o-lantern was nowhere to be seen.
Some penguins swear that there used to be a small cabin at the top of the Ski Hill.
You won't find it on any map now, for it vanished long ago.
They say it belonged to a rescue ranger who watched over the sled races.
He knew every turn of every track.
Most forgot he was there, silently looking out from his cabin,
but he was always ready to help a stranded racer.
One Halloween night, while the island was busy trick-or-treating,
he began carving a new run - longer, steeper, and faster than any before.
Only the most fearless sledders would have dared to race down it.
Some say he lost control and vanished into the dense woodland.
Others believe he's still out there,
building that endless track somewhere beyond the mountain.
What we know for sure is that he never came back.
Weeks passed before anyone noticed he was missing.
His ski goggles were found hanging on a jagged rock just below the cliff's edge,
but the snow had already buried his trail.
Eventually, the cabin was torn down...
and the rescue ranger faded into distant memory...
But every Halloween, a scarecrow appears at the mountain's peak.
Penguins assume Rory puts it there, but he denies it every year.
It sways in the wind, its head tilted, as if watching the sledders below.
Sometimes, when the night is still and the wind drifts down the slopes,
you can see its long shadow move, as if its arm is waving,
and hear a whisper on the breeze...
"Come sled with me..."
And if you're brave enough to climb the mountain after dark,
you might see it turn. Ever so slowly, it points towards the cliff edge,
as the wind picks up and a voice behind you murmurs…
"...I'll see you at the end..."
Long ago, there was a very cheerful boat.
It carried music and lights all around our beloved Club Penguin Journey…
Penguins would climb aboard, vendors sold sweet treats,
and a lamplighter hung glowing lanterns like stars on a string.
On a distant Halloween night, someone arrived with an old music box.
He said its tune made even the shadows want to dance.
That night there was a big deck party: everyone moved to the music and laughed together.
Then a strange storm came without warning.
The rain seemed to whisper names, and the wind carried echoes from faraway places.
Suddenly, the music box began to play by itself, slow and low:
pling… plong….
Not even 5 seconds passed, a HUGE wave pushed the boat into the Dock that we all know nowadays.
The current dragged it to a bend where the land hugged the water
and mud held the hull with invisible hands.
The fellow penguins walked toward the shore, frightened.
The boat remained trapped in the mud, appearing on unexpected occasions.
The silence did not last long, the music box kept playing,
even though no one touched it.
At first there were broken notes, but soon it became a steady murmur,
as if unseen hands were turning the crank without rest.
And the swollen wood of the boat creaked in a strange rhythm:
creak… crack… creak… crack….
It was not the sound of the sea, it was the sound of footsteps
moving up and down the empty deck.
Those who returned days later swore they saw shadows passing behind the sealed windows,
and heard laughter mixed with sobbing.
Others say the boat is still trying to repeat the last party,
that the echoes keep dancing again and again, never stopping.
Today, when someone dares to come too close,
the water seems to push the boat slowly toward them.
If you listen carefully, you'll hear the music box playing the same tune from that night,
as if every note were trying to drag you into the swamp with it.
Gather round, me hearties!
This here tale begins with me whistlin' away at the helm of the Migrator…
A gentle breeze was flowin' through 'er sails, full moon beamin' down on us.
All of a sudden, me one good eye spotted somethin' glintin' from a passing island.
I thought to me'self… whether it be a chest of doubloons, a rare ruby—
or a mere piece of scrap metal… it's got a tale to tell, and I wanna hear it!
As we drifted slowly t'wards the light, it grew even more powerful n' enticin'.
It was beckonin' me!
By the time we'd anchored, I was practically flyin' down the gangway with excitement!
But then, right when me flipper first met the sand… it disappeared.
A breeze came from amidst the trees with a chill even this old pirate had never experienced.
Me bones began to rattle… even Yarr was too shak'n to leave me shoulder!
The same moon that lit up the seas—
was now drowned in clouds as dark as the tall trees before me.
Those trees… they started whisperin'… almost… melodically.
It was if somethin' came over me… they called me closer… and I obliged.
With each step, I was met with a new pair of distant eyes within the dark.
But still… not a sound.
Not a gentle wave on the shore.
Just the whispers of the trees…
I was so close… searchin' amongst the void for a treasure unknown.
As I gazed intently, almost fully engulfed by the darkness—
I reached out and balanced me'self on a tree.
Just as I started to make out a shrouded figure…
A sudden rustle!
The SNAP of a twig!
The arctic cold breeze picked up to somethin' fierce and knocked me on me back!
Yarr hid himself within me fallen hat, as those whispers roared into an enigmatic chorus!
As I looked up in a daze, the figure was… flying… right at us!
Then I realised… I could see right through it!
The figure seemed to multiply as it ducked and darted between the trees—
until the whole forest was filled with glowin' figures, all after me n' Yarr!
"IT BE…" I gulped…
"GHOSTSSS!!"
I was frozen in the sand by a fear once unthinkable, and deafened by the wails of the invisible orchestra.
Then, one after another, they shot out of the trees and engulfed me as if I were the eye of a storm!
Hooks, ripped shirts, n' even an old skeletal parrot filled the air around me.
This must'a been a marooned pirate crew!
With a mighty howl, I grabbed me hat and stumbled back towards the shore.
In me state of shock, there was no time to prepare the Migrator!
I spotted a rickety ol' rowboat from years past, hopped in, and got to rowin'!
I looked back to see the ghouls cacklin' and fadin' back into the forest to await their next victim.
With a sigh of relief, I raised me flipper to wipe the sweat off me forehead…
and I could still see the island… through me flipper!
And that there be the tale of the ghost island… and the ghost pirate!
I can point ye towards it, if ye keen on explorin' the secrets that be layin' in that decrepit forest for ye'self…
But don't say I didn't warn ye'!
